blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An investigation into flood control projects in Davao City has been widened by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI). This was after the agency claimed to have found projects worth about P7 billion being awarded to a single contractor from 2018 to 2024. NBI Director Melvin Matibag said on Thursday that the bureau initially believed it was looking into only P1.9 billion worth of projects awarded to Genesis88 Construction Inc., a contractor he described as close to the Duterte family. “[But] it turned out that the P1.9 billion in projects given to one contractor that we were looking […]...
